user.title: DEC Deepal — Country
user.description: Choose the country of your Deepal account.

email.title: Sign in by email
email.description:
Enter the email address of your Deepal account. You will receive a code.

Recommended: a secondary account with the car shared to it, so the app on your phone is not signed out.

code_menu.title: Code sent
code_menu.description: Deepal has accepted to send the code to {destination}. It can take a couple of minutes; check the spam folder too. If it does not arrive, resend it or correct the email address.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Enter the code you have just received.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Your account has several cars. Tick the ones you want to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Deepal session is no longer valid (the same account was probably signed in on the app). A new code will be requested.

error.send_code_failed: The code could not be sent. Check the details you entered.
error.too_many_codes: Too many codes have been requested. Wait a while and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Deepal server.
error.login_failed: Could not sign in. Check the code.

abort.reauth_account_mismatch: That account does not have the same vehicles as the configured one. Sign in with the right account.
abort.catalog_error: One of the integration's catalogues has errors. Check the Home Assistant log.

model.title: Model of {vehicle}
model.description: Until you choose the model, the car works in generic mode (basic data only, without seats, steering wheel or PIN control). Model recognised by name: {suggestion}.

details.title: Version and colour
details.description: Version and colour of your {model}. The version decides which entities are created (for example, seat ventilation only exists on the Max) and, together with the colour, the "Side view".

data_description.wheels: The Pro always has its 18" wheel.

vehicle_model_mismatch.title: Check the model of {vehicle}: the car says it is a {detected}

model.title: Model of {vehicle}
model.description: {vehicle} is set up as a different model, but the car says it is a {suggestion}. Choose the right model: it decides which entities are created (e.g. the PHEV fuel ones).

details.title: Version and colour
details.description: Version and colour of your {model}. The version decides which entities are created (for example, seat ventilation only exists on the Max) and, together with the colour, the "Side view".

data_description.wheels: The Pro always has its 18" wheel.

confirm.title: Add {vehicle}
confirm.description: {vehicle} is in your Deepal account but not in the integration. Press Submit to add it; then the "Set up your vehicle" notice will appear so you can choose its model. If you don't want it in Home Assistant, ignore this notice.

vehicle_removed.title: {vehicle} is no longer in your account

confirm.title: Remove {vehicle}
confirm.description: {vehicle} no longer appears in your Deepal account (was it unshared?). Press Submit to remove it from Home Assistant with its entities. Its maintenance, inspection and insurance records are kept in case it comes back.

session_expired.message: The Deepal session expired and could not be renewed. Sign in again in the integration. ({error})

rate_limited.message: Deepal asks to wait (too many requests or attempts). ({error})

pin_problem.message: Problem with the remote control PIN: check it in the DEC Deepal panel (Settings) or in the official app. ({error})

signing_key_invalid.message: The command signing key is no longer valid. Sign in again in the integration. ({error})

command_not_ready.message: The command cannot be sent yet: {error}

connection_error.message: Could not connect to the Deepal server. ({error})

command_rejected_asleep.message: The car rejected the command ({error}). It may be asleep or busy: try again after using it for a while.

command_rejected_power_on.message: The car must be switched off for this command ({error}). Switch it off and try again.

command_vehicle_asleep.message: The car did not accept the command: it may be asleep or offline. Press "Refresh vehicle data" to wake it up and try again. ({error})

wake_no_report.message: The car was asked to wake up, but it has not sent new data in 60 seconds. It may have no coverage; the last data is kept.

command_busy.message: Another command has been running for this car for too long. Try again in a few seconds.

command_cooldown.message: The car is still finishing the previous command. Wait {seconds} s.

unknown_device.message: That device is not a DEC Deepal vehicle.

maintenance_not_configured.message: First enable servicing for this car in the DEC Deepal panel (Vehicles).

itv_not_configured.message: First enable ITV for this car in the DEC Deepal panel (Vehicles).

maintenance_no_odometer.message: The car's mileage is not known. Enter the kilometres, or register the service from the DEC Deepal panel.

capture_snapshot.name: Debug capture
capture_snapshot.description: Saves a full snapshot of the car's state (interpreted and raw data, without personal data) and compares it with the previous capture. It is also saved in /config/dec_deepal_capturas/.

label.name: Label
label.description: A name to recognise the capture (for example "A - idle").

refresh.name: Read first
refresh.description: Read the car just before capturing.

register_itv.name: Register ITV
register_itv.description: Records that the car has passed the ITV (roadworthiness test) and calculates the next one. ITV must be enabled for the car in the DEC Deepal panel.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The car that has passed the ITV.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the ITV. If left empty, today.

register_maintenance.name: Register service
register_maintenance.description: Records that the car has been serviced and starts counting for the next one. Servicing must be enabled for the car in the DEC Deepal panel.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The car that has been serviced.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the service. If left empty, today.

km.name: Kilometres
km.description: Kilometres at the service. If left empty, the car's current reading.
